purpose: Dark card artwork: levels 1 and 2 development previews; level 3 approved production source

prompts.prompt:
Use case: lighting-weather / precise-object-edit. Asset type: dark-theme test-level card artwork, landscape 3:2.
Input image is the EDIT TARGET. Keep exactly the same sculptural folded ribbon geometry, number of folds, silhouette, camera, composition, object size and placement as the input. This is a matched dark companion, not a new sculpture.
Change the pale backdrop and ground into a seamless deep olive #292e24 to #343c27 studio background belonging to this lime and olive test palette. Change lighting to soft, controlled night studio lighting: readable edges, soft contact shadow, restrained luminous rim, no bright patch of floor or pale rectangle anywhere. The sculptural object stays clearly identifiable and uses only lime #d3e38c, olive midtones; neutral silvery highlights may remain. Remove cross-palette colored accents and reflections. This should blend naturally into the dark test card surface.
Premium smooth satin-metallic 3D render, quiet and sharp, no grain. Preserve reference geometry and 3:2 framing. No text, logos, borders, UI, added objects or new motifs. Entire output is a single opaque artwork.
